  square on top in the icons shape. Shapes: grid3, grid4, icons (three columns).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Question, FaqSplitLabels } from "../blocks/faq-split.types";

export type FaqCardsProps = {
  items: Question[];
  labels: FaqSplitLabels;
  cards?: "grid3" | "grid4" | "icons";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";

const { items, labels, cards = "grid3" } = defineProps<FaqCardsProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Box
    :class="
      (cards as string) === 'grid4' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4'
      : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3'
    "
    data-testid="faq"
  >
    <Block v-for="q in items" :key="q.id"
      tag="article"
      class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-6"
      data-testid="faq-card"
    >
      <Box
        v-if="((cards as string) === 'icons')"
        class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted"
      >
        <LucideIcon :name="q.icon" :size="20" />
      </Box>
      <Stack gap="2">
        <Badge variant="secondary" size="sm" class="w-fit">
          {{ q.category }}
        </Badge>
        <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="semibold">
          {{ q.question }}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ q.answer }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
      <Box class="mt-auto">
        <Link href="#/faq" variant="default" size="sm" class="font-medium">
          {{ labels.more }}
          <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" :size="16" />
        </Link>
      </Box>
    </Block>
  </Box>
